{{Top}}
'''Specialist''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was below a [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] and above a [[Private/Legends|Private]]. Specialists were also used in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], where they denoted [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] tasked with performing specialist tasks inside combat [[Squad/Legends|squads]], such as heavy weapons operators.

This rank was in use in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]].<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
